scripts.release:check: python3 scripts/source_guard.py && python3 scripts/sqlite_query_audit.py --strict && python3 scripts/release_checks.py
scripts.audit: python3 -m pip_audit -r requirements.lock.txt --strict && python3 -m pip_audit -r requirements-ocr.lock.txt --no-deps --strict && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix Frontend --audit-level=high && npm audit --prefix desktop --audit-level=high
scripts.package: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run package --prefix desktop
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run package:mac --prefix desktop
scripts.release:macos: python3 scripts/release_checks.py --distribution --signing macos && npm run package:mac
